title: Workload Definition Pack body
description: Classifies estate resources into workload/tier/role. Consumed by the Discovery module (classify + definitions_from_packs).
$comment: When the pack-level 'workload' is absent, every definition must assign at least one label (workload/tier/role) — a selector-only entry would inherit nothing and be a no-op that can shadow later definitions (discovery/module.py:87-90,106-112).

workload.description: Optional default workload kind entries inherit when they omit their own (discovery/module.py:106-112).

items.description: A selector→label entry. classify() matches on resourceType and/or a tagKey/tagValue pair (discovery/module.py:77-85), so at least one meaningful selector is required and tagKey/tagValue must appear together.

resourceType.description: Azure resource type matched case-insensitively against discovered nodes (discovery/module.py:77-83).
